cases.refreshed: Free. Registration Required. Please call (408) 350-3239 Monday-Friday between 8 AM-5 PM to set up a free one-on-one counseling appointment. Do you have questions about Medicare or Medi-Cal? Sourcewise's HICAP counselors offer one-on-one counseling for those looking to make an informed decision about their Medicare and Medi-Cal options. HICAP Counselors answer questions about: Original Medicare (Part A & B); Medicare Advantage Plans (Part C); Prescription Drug Coverage (Part D); Supplemental Insurance (Medigap); Limited Income Programs for Medicare; Medicare and Medi-Cal Options; Tips for Avoiding Medicare Fraud. Appointments are available in other languages upon request. HICAP Counselors do not sell or endorse and are not affiliated with any insurance companies. HICAP's goal is to inform and educate the community so that individuals can make an informed decision about their healthcare options.

events.title: Finance with AI for Small Business Owners

cases.refreshed: Presented by Bizzaly in partnership with Silicon Valley SBDC – Northern Ca Network. This in-person training workshop helps small business owners cut through AI hype and put it to work on real financial tasks. Attendees will leave with a repeatable prompting framework and a set of ready-to-use prompts for budgeting, forecasting, cash flow analysis, and fundraising – plus a clear sense of where AI helps most and where a human still needs to check the work. Nationally, 76% of small businesses now use AI in some form, and 91% of those using it report a revenue boost – yet most owners still don't feel confident using it for anything beyond drafting text. This workshop provides you with the tools and confidence to run your finances for decision-making with ease. Cover Topics: 1. What Is AI? • Demystifying artificial intelligence and large language models • How today's AI tools actually work – and where the industry stands right now 2. How to Use AI Effectively • The Clear prompt method: Context, Lens, Expected Outcome, Assets, Review • A repeatable framework for getting usable results on the first try 3. AI for Finance • Forecasting – modeling best-case, worst-case, and likely revenue scenarios • Budgeting – drafting a starter budget and categorizing expenses in minutes • Cash flow analysis – spotting trends and risks before they become a crisis • Fundraising – drafting pitch narratives and prepping for investor Q&A • Grant writing – turning your facts into a funder-ready narrative • Guardrails – what to verify, and what never to paste into a chat window This workshop is brought to you by the Bizzaly team – your business ally for putting AI to work smarter. Free. No registration required. Presented by Silicon Valley Small Business Development Center. Silicon Valley SBDC is part of a 40-year national legacy committed to small business success. With unparalleled access to no-cost expertise from entrepreneurs who have seen it all, Silicon Valley SBDC at San Jose State University provides small businesses with the solutions they seek and the confidence they need to realize their dreams. Parking validation for the garage at 88 S. 4th Street will be provided at the program. E-newsletter Signup: Get the inside scoop on business and career resources at SJPL. Sign up today for our monthly e-newsletter, highlighting the latest programs, e-resources and services available at the San José Public Library. #sjplworksbusiness

events.title: The Thrifty Table: Creating Beautiful Holiday Centerpieces

cases.refreshed: Are you experiencing the "holiday guest stress syndrome"? Don't let the pressure of having a perfect tablescape wilt your holiday spirit! Join Uc Master Gardeners Laura Westley, Sue Neufeld, and Bernie Day for an inspiring, hands-on demonstration designed to take the stress—and the high cost—out of holiday decorating. You don't need a professional florist or a massive budget to create a "wow" factor for your dining room. What You'll Learn: The Art of the "Found" Object: Learn how to scout your own backyard or junk drawer for unique textures, greenery, and accents that add character to any arrangement. Grocery Store Glam: Discover how to deconstruct those affordable supermarket flower bunches and reimagine them into high-end-looking centerpieces. Pro-Tips for Longevity: Get the inside scoop on keeping your flora fresh from the first toast to the final slice of pie. Why join us? Whether you're hosting a grand feast or an intimate gathering, you'll walk away with the confidence and practical skills to transform "ordinary" items into extraordinary focal points. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
